d:
Are old supercars pointless?!
Is this one of the weirdest line-ups we’ve ever had on the channel?
We’ve got our hands on one of the all-time great Lamborghinis - the Murciélago LP640. And it’s lining up against… a Volvo EX90?!
You may think this race is completely pointless, pitting a 7-seat family SUV against a classic supercar. But these cars are actually more closely matched than you may think! Let’s take a closer look at the stats…
